## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated a failing test before behavior changes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] This change contains no real personal data, credentials, tokens, databases, logs, private URLs, or machine-specific paths.
- [ ] Tests and screenshots use clearly synthetic data only.
- [ ] New external-provider or network data flows are documented in `PRIVACY.md`.
- [ ] I did not weaken privacy, secret, or public-export checks to make a fixture pass.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Existing environment variables, on-disk data/token filenames, and API behavior remain compatible, or the migration is documented.
